title: Masterpass payment confirmation
slide_intent: Show identity at a service completion moment because customers need to connect a digital payment experience with the trusted payment brand.
strategic_value: A shared symbol can link the service name, stored card and confirmation screen.
demonstration: A hand holds a white phone displaying Masterpass, a World card, a green check and an orange return control.
practical_value: Inspect how identity and confirmation information occupy separate parts of a small screen.

content_islands.name: Hand and device
content_islands.spec: Retain the hand holding the centered white phone on the pale background.

content_islands.name: Payment screen
content_islands.spec: Stack the Masterpass signature, card image, confirmation check and orange return control.

reference_purposes.Application: The caption identifies Masterpass on mobile.
reference_purposes.Intent: Pentagram states that the mark creates a single system for the company and its products, beginning with Masterpass implementation.
